title: Dallas Cowboys could trade WR George Pickens for a 2nd round pick

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Dallas Cowboys could trade WR George Pickens for a 2nd round pick
sources.description: According to NFL Network’s lead league insider Ian Rapoport, the Dallas Cowboys are expected to place the franchise tag on star wide receiver George Pickens. However, instead of keeping him or signing him to an extension, Rapoport mentioned that they could trade him for a second-round pick. So, with it being “what if” season, let’s […]
